name: Eligibility Verification by Home Education Students (Cocurricular / Courses)
description: Required documents and verification of eligibility or prerequisites before try-outs, auditions or course enrollment.
deadline: prior to trying out, auditioning or enrolling
quote: Prior to trying-out or auditioning for a cocurricular activity or enrolling in an academic course, a home education student shall submit required documents and written verification of eligibility or completion of prerequisites to the building principal or designee.
